description: Two maintainers decline a hard-coded localhost URL finding in examples/ on two PRs. Outcome learning proposes the learning after the second, and the third example shouldn't raise it.

correction.reason: Examples run against a local server on purpose; a localhost URL in an example is what readers expect.

files.examples/basic.ts:
import { client } from "../src/client";
export const api = client("http://localhost:8080");

target.title: Hard-coded localhost URL in the example
